## Summary

What changes for users or maintainers, and why?

## Related issue

Link relevant issues. Use Closes #… when this resolves an issue.

## Verification

List the exact commands and results. For changes to Surface, include a small
example or describe the editor workflow tested. Use public or synthetic data.

## Compatibility

Describe migration, diagnostics, security, or performance effects that apply.
Mark incompatible changes in the title with ! or include a BREAKING CHANGE:
footer in the commit description.

## Checklist

- [ ] The title and commits use Conventional Commits in English.
- [ ] Relevant tests, documentation, or examples cover the change.
- [ ] The patch and history contain only material suitable for publication.
